groupedHumanDecisions.rationale: The frozen noncausal/prior governed propositions remain unchanged; no new causal traversal.
Existing bounded causal mechanisms may remain as V1-incomplete without any claim expansion or execution upgrade.
Exact causal or endpoint alignment is insufficient; each record retains its separate rationale and remains unchanged.
Availability, task framing, threat-message content, correction, and instruction must not be equated with recipient processing, traits, behavior or universal outcomes.
Landscape signal or exact component isolation is inadequate; no formal candidate is minted.
The plausible A&E routes lack isolated exact operation-to-target evidence; no EffectAssertion is recommended.

individualScientificDecisions.rationale: Arrival rate contributes mechanically to window-relative volume; formula dependence is not independent causality.
Message length is a volume input under a declared window, not an independent causal effect on the calculated ratio.
Evidence quality can be one input to argument strength only when inference relevance is specified.
Citation traceability is a component of process transparency, not an independently observed outcome.
Including a counterargument is input to possible refutation, but does not prove refutation strength.
Source identity disclosure can enable provenance reconstruction but disclosure alone is not verified provenance.
Spacing redistributes a fixed count over time; frequency depends on the specified window.
Correction delay concerns timing after an earlier claim; it does not cause correction presence.
Narrative coherence and evidence presence are distinct content codings with possible component overlap.
Causal structure is a component of coherence under a declared coding rule.
Threat-severity content can be part of a warning label but label presence is not a causal effect.
A claim of prevalence is not necessarily consensus or endorsement by a relevant group.
Specificity and detail have overlapping coding components; no independent causal effect identified.
An alternative explanation contributes correction content under a declared coding rule.
Implementation steps can be one component of guidance completeness, not an independent effect.
Action-time specification can be one component of guidance completeness, not an independent effect.
Near-exact referent mismatch and bundled supporting experiments leave the exact content-property edge insufficient; preserve the source findings and null on the separate intention outcome.
A named-group prevalence statement is a reusable presentation identity distinct from the existing personalized comparison panel. Identity does not imply efficacy or truthful content.

blockedDecisions.rationale: Exact versioned derivation and constituent/aggregate source use require future architecture/governance review before new execution.
Blocked Message Cohesion metadata may not be repaired in this candidate audit.
